_comment_agent: C enum (NONE=0, VDPAU=1, CUDA, VAAPI, DXVA2, QSV, VIDEOTOOLBOX, D3D11VA, DRM, OPENCL, MEDIACODEC, VULKAN, D3D12VA, AMF, OHCODEC=14), no fields, no lifecycle; every enumerator is non-negative so bindgen backs ffi::AVHWDeviceType by c_uint. Stored in AVHWDeviceContext.type, which av_hwdevice_ctx_alloc sets from hw_table and hwcontext.h documents as 'set when this struct is allocated and never changed afterwards': the field is read-only for users, because backends dispatch on it and cast hwctx by it (hwcontext_cuda.c:854, hwcontext_vulkan.c:2156, hwcontext_opencl.c:1222 switch on src_ctx->type in device_derive; av_hwdevice_ctx_create_derived_opts returns an ancestor whose p.type equals the requested type), so a user write would make C read one backend's hwctx as another's. Also stored in libavcodec AVCodecHWConfig.device_type, in static const codec tables. Returned by av_hwdevice_find_type_by_name (NONE for unknown names; strcmp, i.e. case-sensitive although the header says case-insensitive) and av_hwdevice_iterate_types (NONE once exhausted; NONE as prev starts the walk), and taken by value by av_hwdevice_get_type_name (NULL unless NONE < type < FF_ARRAY_ELEMS(hw_type_names), so any value is accepted; libavcodec decode.c:1090, ohdec.c:157 and libavfilter vf_amf_common.c:221 pass its result to %s unchecked), av_hwdevice_ctx_alloc/create/create_derived(_opts) (a linear hw_table lookup by equality: an unknown or not-compiled type fails with NULL/ENOSYS) and libavcodec's ff_decode_get_hw_frames_ctx. C accepts every value as input, and new FFmpeg minor versions append enumerators that a newer runtime libavutil returns, so the value set is open. Wrapped (hwcontext wave 0 batch 0) as DeviceType, a Copy transparent newtype over the raw enum accepting every bit pattern (CPlainElem), Default = NONE. The campaign builds compile no hwcontext backend (--disable-autodetect), so hw_table is empty there. Corrected by the hwcontext wave-0 type review: the translator's note called AVHWDeviceContext.type a field users may write.
